title: Analyse why the own outcome check overrates explainers vs independent
summary: Goal: for the person running Athena, who has relayed four times that an independent reader rated the explainer lower than Athena's own check, write down why the check overrates and what to change. This is a docs change: an evidence-cited analysis of the latest case (intervention 20261015-234842-fhxz, 3 vs 4) and the earlier cases, plus a recorded decision. It does not rebuild the gate from job 20261014-163844-c2kt.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require claims to cite records and files and counts to be labeled measured or estimated.
The doc must read standalone for an outside reader.
Criterion forbids secrets and personal data.
Decision records alternatives before any follow-up build.
One docs-only change; the gate rebuild is left as a follow-up.
Existing cargo test, clippy and fmt checks must still pass.
The check is whether the reader can see the cause and follow-up, not that a file exists.
The analysis targets why the check overrates, not the single instance.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: understand and write down why Athena's own check overrates; the audience is the person running Athena, who judges whether the analysis is evidence-based and actionable.

Interpreted 'latest case was never analysed' as: introspection k3c6 failed (agent version 2.1.301 vs pinned 2.1.299), so a human-readable analysis is needed; the proposal's design-decisions rung implies a written decision, not code.

Job 20261014-163844-c2kt (rejected: gate never wired) is addressed by not repeating it; its blocker/major findings are carried forward as the named follow-up, its minor/nit findings no longer apply because its files are dropped.
setup.sh is named only as the place the version pin is fixed; this job does not change it.
No code is changed, so no Code survey is needed; criteria are checkable by reading the doc and by Grep.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/outcome-check-overrates.md exists and analyses the latest case, intervention 20261015-234842-fhxz (own check 4 of 5, independent reader 3), stating its cause: the check confirms quoted sources exist but not that the model's described behavior matches the code. The cause is supported by citations to the repository files it read (for example crates/athena-core/src/audience.rs and xtask/src/site.rs), which a reader can open.

The analysis cites the earlier case intervention 20261014-154713-z9rx (2 of 5) and job 20261014-163844-c2kt, and says plainly which of the 'four times' it could find in the records and which it could not; any count is labeled as measured or estimated.

The analysis addresses job 20261014-163844-c2kt: it says its findings (gate never invoked on a ship path, wiring and xtask checks missing) are not re-done here, and that its candidate files (crates/athena-cap-study/src/newcomer.rs, prompts/newcomer.md, crates/athena-cap-study/Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs) are dropped, not kept.

The doc records one decision with at least two alternatives considered and a chosen follow-up (a concrete, separately requestable change), and notes that introspection k3c6 failed because the agent version was not the pinned one, so the latest case had no automated analysis.
docs/decisions.md gains an entry for this decision that links to the new doc, and CHANGELOG.md has a line for the change; Grep for 'outcome-check-overrates' finds both.
Public default: no secrets or personal data (no email addresses) appear in the added text, and it reads standalone for an outside reader.
Running cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check passes unchanged, including any tests that validate docs/spec.toml or markdown links, since no code changes.
No governance files change: setup.sh, athena.toml, defaults.toml, rust-toolchain.toml, .gitattributes and .github/workflows are untouched by the diff (git diff shows none of them).

out_of_scope: setup.sh (the agent version mismatch in introspection k3c6 is only cited, not fixed)
athena.toml, defaults.toml, rust-toolchain.toml, .gitattributes and CI workflows under .github/

Rebuilding or wiring the newcomer gate from job 20261014-163844-c2kt: crates/athena-cap-study/src/newcomer.rs, crates/athena-cap-study/prompts/newcomer.md, crates/athena-cap-study/Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs, xtask/src/site.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/wiring.rs, crates/athena-core/src/capability.rs, crates/athena-core/src/fake.rs, crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs, docs/architecture.md, docs/design/explainer-site.md (dropped or untouched)
Any code change or new rule that refuses readings
departures: Docs-only change should cost less than the reference median; verification risk is mainly the analysis being judged unsupported.
